title: Stay Grounded
synopsis: All-handy guy sails across space in the search for info on his lover’s mother, who cursed the latter with a terminal illness before disappearing. His friend’s mom is a goddess. Every planet has a sole goddess. When one of these entities gives birth to a “male”, she is set to turn human, unless of course they go through the ritual of eliminating the offspring through a curse. The protagonist meets plenty of goddesses while working as an electrician and a massage therapist.
